cases.text:
INT. RESTAURANT - NIGHT
PRIYA (30), red dress, statement earrings, waits at a corner table. She checks her watch.
RAJ (32) arrives in a crisp white shirt, sleeves rolled, top button open.
PRIYA:
  You're late.
RAJ:
  (sitting)
  Traffic.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT
Rain hammers down. Raj runs across the road, his shirt now soaked through. Priya's dupatta drags in the mud.
RAJ:
  Get in!

INT. RAJ'S FLAT - CONTINUOUS
Raj peels off the wet shirt and pulls on a grey hoodie. He kicks off his shoes.
LATER
He emerges in a navy blazer, hair combed.

INT. NEWSROOM - DAY
The editor's patience is wearing thin. Boots on the ground, he tells them, that's what this story needs. Raj watches him go, then pockets his phone. Priya purses her lips and ties up the loose ends of the story.
EDITOR:
  Keep your shirt on, Raj.

INT. BEDROOM - MORNING
Priya rummages through the wardrobe.
PRIYA:
  Where's my red dress? The one with the sequins?
RAJ:
  (pulling on his jacket)
  Laundry.
PRIYA:
  You gave the waiter your jacket last night.

EXT. CAPE TOWN HARBOUR - DAY
BANG. A car backfires. CRASH! Crates tumble off a truck. Inspector Pandey, in full uniform, steps out of the jeep. He adjusts his cap and checks the boot of the car.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT
Raj slumps on a bench. Priya sits beside him. She wraps her cardigan tighter. His shirt is still blood-stained from the fight.
A NURSE hurries past.

EXT. POLICE STATION - DAY
TWENTY CONSTABLES in khaki line up in the rain. Inspector Pandey inspects them, umbrella in hand. Behind them, a crowd of protesters waves placards.

INT. RESTAURANT - LATER
Same table, same people. Raj is still in the white shirt, now with a coffee stain on the cuff. Priya has changed into a yellow kurta.
RAJ:
  Sorry about that.

INT. BATHROOM - MORNING
Raj steps out of the shower in a towel, barefoot. Priya, in a bathrobe, eats cereal on the edge of the tub and spills milk down her front.

INT. BAR - NIGHT
Raj raises his glass. Two glasses of whisky sit between them. Priya twists the ring on her finger, then pushes her glasses up her nose. Raj loosens his tie. A phone rings. He checks his watch.

INT. RAJ'S HOUSE - DAY
Raj's Mother, in a cream silk saree, fusses over the puja thali. Raj's kurta is crumpled from the train. She straightens his collar.

INT. TAILOR'S SHOP - DAY
Rows of sherwanis hang on the wall. A framed photo shows a younger Raj in army uniform. Raj imagines himself in a tuxedo and laughs. His shoulders are like a coat hanger. He tries on an ivory sherwani. It fits like a glove.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DUSK
Wearing matching black hoodies, Raj and Priya sprint across the gravel. Raj's stunt double takes the fall onto the tin roof. A gunshot. Blood blooms on Priya's sleeve.

INT. WEDDING HALL - NIGHT
Pandey, out of uniform in a plain kurta, scans the guests. Raj, dressed as a waiter in a white shirt and black waistcoat, carries a tray. THE BARAAT arrives, fifty guests in sherwanis and lehengas.

INT. OFFICE - DAY
Inspector Pandey looks worse for wear. He tightens his belt, literally, another notch, and straightens his badge. Behind him a poster of a man in a cape.
PANDEY:
  (loosening his collar)
  Get me Raj.

EXT. WEDDING MANDAP - DAY
MEERA (25) in a red banarasi lehenga, heavy gold jewellery, mehendi up to her elbows, sits by the fire. Around her, two hundred guests in wedding finery. VIKRAM wears an ivory sherwani and a safa.
PANDIT:
  Kanyadaan ke liye taiyaar ho jaaiye.

EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT
Rain hammers down. ARJUN drags DEV out of the car. They fight in the mud. Dev's white shirt is soaked and torn. Blood runs from Arjun's nose onto his collar.
DEV:
  Enough!

EXT. VILLAGE ROAD - DAY
SUPER: TEN YEARS LATER
An older KARAN, grey at the temples, walks with a cane. His khadi kurta is faded and patched.
KARAN:
  Nothing changes here.

INT. PRIYA'S BEDROOM - NIGHT
Priya peels off the wet saree and changes into a cotton nightie. She unhooks her mangalsutra and sets it on the dresser.
PRIYA:
  (to herself)
  Never again.

EXT. RIVER GHAT - DAWN
Ayesha wades into the river fully clothed, her yellow salwar kameez billowing. She dips under. MOTHER watches from the steps, clutching a shawl.
MOTHER:
  Come out. You'll catch cold.

EXT. HAVELI COURTYARD - DAY
Holi. Gulal flies everywhere. Fifty villagers in white kurtas dance to the dhol. Rohan, drenched in pink colour, grabs Nisha and pulls her into the crowd.
NISHA:
  My dupatta! Rohan!

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)
Younger DEV, still in the blood-stained shirt from the alley, paces. A NURSE in scrubs hurries past.
DEV:
  Where is he?

INT. DHABA - NIGHT
Kabir tears into a plate of butter chicken. Sameer knocks over a glass of whisky; it pours across Kabir's lap.
KABIR:
  These are new jeans, you idiot.
SAMEER:
  (laughing)
  Relax.

INT. TAILOR SHOP - DAY
Bolts of silk everywhere. MASTERJI measures Raj for a bandhgala. Raj's mother holds up three swatches: maroon, bottle green, ivory.
RAJ'S MOTHER:
  The maroon. For the sangeet.
RAJ:
  Whatever you say, Ma.

INT. CLINIC - DAY
Six months pregnant, LEELA lowers herself onto the bed. Her arm is in a sling. She slips off her bangles one by one.
DOCTOR:
  Any pain?

INT. BEDROOM - MORNING
Sameer wakes, showers, and throws on yesterday's crumpled shirt.
SAMEER:
  Late. Late, late.

INT. GARDEN CAFE - DAY
ROSE (28), mint green sundress, straw hat, waves at VIOLET, who arrives in a violet saree with a silver clutch.
ROSE:
  You came!

EXT. BEACH - DAY
Inspector Pandey walks along the sand in his khaki uniform and aviator sunglasses. His boots sink into the wet sand.
INSPECTOR PANDEY:
  Nobody swims here after dark.

INT. GARAGE - DAY
Raj watches the door. He ties the rope to the hook, caps the petrol can and rings the bell twice. A coat of paint peels off the wall. He tops up the oil.
RAJ:
  Anyone home?

INT. RESTAURANT - LATER
Priya is still in the red dress from Scene 4, now with a shawl over her shoulders. Raj has changed into a black blazer.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT
Raj's Mother stirs the dal. Raj leans in the doorway.
RAJ'S MOTHER:
  Take off that wet jacket before you sit down. And I saw a beautiful blue sari at the market yesterday.
RAJ:
  Later, Ma. I'll change later.

EXT. POLICE STATION - DAY
Two hundred protesters surge against a line of policemen in riot gear. Inspector Pandey is thrown to the ground. His STUNT DOUBLE takes the fall through the glass door.
INSPECTOR PANDEY:
  Hold the line!

INT. PALACE HALL - DAY
The Maharaja of Rajgarh receives guests. RAJESH, the steward, in a black sherwani, bows. Raj waits at the back in jeans and a faded denim jacket.
RAJ:
  I don't belong here.

INT. OFFICE - DAY
Raj, sleeves rolled to the elbow, top button undone, twists the wedding ring on his finger. The phone rings. He loosens his tie and kicks off his loafers under the desk.

INT. BAR - NIGHT
A drunk shoves Raj. Raj punches him; the drunk's nose bleeds onto Raj's white shirt. Priya, at the bar, spills red wine down her cream blouse.
PRIYA:
  Perfect.

INT. SHIRT FACTORY - FLOOR - DAY (FLASHBACK, 1985)
Rows of women at sewing machines. Young Priya, twelve, in a school uniform two sizes too big, threads a needle. A supervisor in a boiler suit shouts.

EXT. WEDDING VENUE - NIGHT
Raj and Priya, both in matching gold outfits, slip past the guards. Inspector Pandey follows, dressed as a waiter. Fifty wedding guests dance around the baraat.
RAJ:
  Nobody looked twice.

INT. CAR - NIGHT
Priya drives, her knuckles white on the wheel. Raj sits in the passenger seat. She pulls her cardigan tighter.
RAJ:
  (tugging off his gloves)
  Heater's broken again.
PRIYA:
  Put your gloves back on.

INT. HOSPITAL - DAY
The nurse dresses the wound. Raj changes the subject. Loose change rattles in his pocket. The red light above the door blinks; Priya, in a hospital gown, watches the ceiling.
PRIYA:
  Do I look like a ghost?

INT. TRAIN COMPARTMENT - NIGHT
Priya adjusts her red sari. The red sari catches on the berth. She smooths the red sari again and again, then stares out at the rain streaking the window while the train rocks through the night and the other passengers sleep under thin railway blankets that smell of dust and diesel.

INT. STAIRWELL - DAY
Raj enters the flat. Raj waits on the platform. Raj opens the boot and lifts out a box. Raj pops the hood. Raj pulls the shades down. Raj signs the slip and hands it over. Raj reads the specs. Raj kneels before the cross. Raj rides the clutch. Priya arrives with the cast. Priya reaches for the top shelf. Inspector Pandey meets with the top brass. Raj grabs the kit from the glovebox.

INT. FLAT - NIGHT
Raj is still in the flat.

INT. GYM - NIGHT
Raj steps into the ring. Raj climbs into the boot. Raj gets into the top bunk. Raj removes the top from the jar. Raj takes off the cap and drinks. Raj pulls on the chain.

INT. CAFE - DAY
Raj walks in with Payal. Raj arrives in Payal's car. Raj is still in love with Payal.

INT. CAFE - DAY
Raj waits with Nath.

INT. CAFE - DAY
Priya dances with Rakhi. Raj arrives with Chunni. Raj slips into Kit's car. Raj slips into Kara's flat.

INT. HALL - DAY
Raj turns on his heel and leaves. Raj gives the table a coat of varnish. Raj calls a wrap on the day. Raj's face is a mask of indifference. The deal is in the bag. The match ends in a tie. Inspector Pandey explains the chain of command. Raj reaches the top and looks back. Raj peers through a veil of mist. Raj works for the Crown. Raj squeezes a wedge of lemon into the glass. Raj addresses the cast.

EXT. VILLAGE - NIGHT
Raj enters the Boot Inn. Raj waits at the Crown for Priya.

INT. BAR - NIGHT
Priya collects the empty glasses. Raj fills the glasses. CLINK. Raj raises the glasses.

INT. HOTEL RECEPTION - DAY
Raj rings the bell. Raj walks to the reception desk. Priya checks her phone. No reception. Raj has a prior engagement. Raj vacuums the red carpet.

EXT. WEDDING CAKE BAKERY - DAY
Raj waits.

INT. GALA THEATRE - NIGHT
Raj waits.

EXT. STORM DRAIN - DAY
Raj climbs out.

INT. MR SNOW'S OFFICE - DAY
Raj waits.

INT. MONSOON PALACE RESTAURANT - NIGHT
Raj waits.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT - HEAVY RAIN
Raj waits under the awning.

INT. ATTIC - DAY
Raj enters. The walls are covered in dust. Raj looks at the car. It is spattered with mud. Priya stares out. The windows are streaked with rain. Raj looks down. Blood on the back seat. Raj frowns at a coffee stain on the front page.

INT. CAR - DAY
Raj shoots Priya a look. Raj spreads butter with a knife. Raj is wound up about the meeting. Priya's heart beats faster. Raj reads the bullet points aloud. Raj bites the bullet and calls her. A tear rolls down Priya's cheek. Raj's heart leaps. Raj is burning with rage. Raj eats his words. Raj dances around the question. The meeting dragged on for hours. Priya punches numbers into the keypad. Raj hits send. Raj stabs at the lift button. Raj admires the garden, a riot of colour. Raj waves it off, a storm in a teacup. A blast of cold air hits Raj. Raj fights back tears. Raj kicks himself. Raj shoves past Priya. Raj climbs the corporate ladder fast. The smoke alarm chirps. Raj watches a motorcycle roar past. Priya climbs the stairs.

EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT
A drunk shoves Raj. Raj punches him. Raj climbs the fence and jumps off the wall.

INT. OFFICE - DAY
RAJ:
  This is my top priority.
INSPECTOR PANDEY:
  This is my watch. Nothing happens on my watch.

INT. BAR - NIGHT
Raj owes money to the mob. Police in white vans block the road. An angry mob of villagers surrounds the jeep.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT
Raj drops the ring and it rolls under the bed.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT
Raj is soaked to the skin. Priya is drenched. Raj is soaking wet. Priya is dishevelled. Raj, dripping wet, glares. Priya is wet through.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT
It is raining hard. Raj and Priya run for cover, soaked.

EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT
Raj tears his sleeve on the fence. Raj's kurta tears. Priya rips her skirt on a nail. Inspector Pandey's sleeve is torn. Inspector Pandey's shirt rips at the shoulder. Priya's heel snaps.

INT. CAR - NIGHT
Priya is in the same clothes as the night before. Raj, same clothes as Sc. 12, drives. Raj in the same clothes. Raj hasn't changed since the party.

INT. ROOM - DAY
Priya, still in her wedding lehenga, sits. Raj, in running shoes and an evening jacket, waits.

INT. ROOM - DAY
Raj waits.
FLASHBACK:
A younger Raj runs through a field.
FLASHBACK TO:
Raj as a boy.
BACK TO PRESENT.
Raj, older now, sighs.

INT. OFFICE - DAY
RAJ (35), an architect in a navy blazer, waits. INSPECTOR PANDEY (50), a heavyset man in khaki, enters.

INT. HALL - DAY
Raj is dressed in black. Priya, dressed in white from head to toe, enters. Both are in black.

INT. ROOM - DAY
Raj's Mother ties a pagdi on Raj's head. Priya fastens a watch on Raj's wrist. Raj drapes his jacket over Priya's shoulders. Priya wears Raj's shirt.

INT. CAFE - DAY
PRIYA:
  You're wearing the same shirt as yesterday.
PRIYA:
  Same shirt again? You look like a mess.
RAJ:
  I haven't been home.

EXT. ROAD - DAY
Raj, sweating through his shirt, runs. Sweat stains his kurta. Sweat pours down his face. Priya emerges from the water, saree clinging to her. Raj crawls out of the river. Priya wrings out her dupatta.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY
Priya's dupatta catches fire. Priya's sleeve catches fire. The dupatta burns.

INT. HOUSE - NIGHT
PRIYA:
  (soaked, shivering)
  Give me a towel.
RAJ:
  (wet, muddy)
  Hi.

INT. HOUSE - DAY
Priya pulls her pallu over her head as Raj's Mother enters. Raj's Mother, in a widow's white saree, sits.

INT. ROOM - DAY
Raj changes his shirt. Priya changes clothes. Raj gets changed. Raj strips to his vest.

INT. ROOM - DAY
Priya wears the same saree as in Scene 4. Raj is dressed as before. Priya wears the outfit from the wedding.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY
The women smear haldi on Raj's face and kurta. Priya, gulal-smeared, laughs.

INT. TEMPLE - DAWN
Raj is bare-chested, a janeu across his torso, in a white dhoti.

EXT. POOL - NIGHT
Raj is pushed into the pool. Raj shoves Priya into the water.

INT. CANTEEN - DAY
A food fight breaks out.

INT. ROOM - DAY
Priya's mangalsutra is missing. Raj is hatless. Raj's hands are bloody.

INT. FLAT - DAY
Raj wears a kurta and Priya wears a saree.

INT. FLAT - DAY
Raj wears a kurta while Priya wears a green saree. Raj wears a kurta; Priya wears a saree and a shawl.

INT. FLAT - DAY
RAJ (40) in a tweed jacket and PRIYA (35) in a red saree enter. Raj, 30, in a kurta, and Priya, 28, in a saree, enter.

INT. BEDROOM - MORNING
Priya wears Raj's shirt. Priya, wearing Raj's oversized hoodie, opens the door. Vikram, in Raj's old jacket, waits. Priya, in Raj's shirt and nothing else, makes tea. Raj puts on Priya's coat and leaves.

INT. TRAILER - DAY
Meena, the dresser, hands Raj a pressed white kurta. He steps into the kurta.

INT. TRAILER - DAY
Priya, in a red saree, hands Raj a blue shirt.

EXT. GHAT - NIGHT
Raj drapes a shawl over Priya. Raj drapes his coat over Priya's shoulders.

INT. FLAT - DAY
Priya's mother hands her the shawl. Priya wraps the shawl around her shoulders.

INT. FLAT - DAY
Priya hands him the tie. He knots the tie.

INT. FLAT - DAY
Raj and Priya stand close.
PRIYA:
  (straightening his tie)
  There.

INT. FLAT - DAY
Priya hands Raj's shirt to him. He pulls on the shirt.

INT. FLAT - NIGHT
Raj, Priya and Vikram sit in their pyjamas.

EXT. ROAD - DAY
Raj wears a torn, muddy shirt. Later he wears a torn, muddy, blood-stained, faded, oversized, borrowed, sweat-soaked, wrinkled cotton shirt.

INT. HALL - NIGHT
Priya wears a red evening gown. Raj wears a blue power suit. Priya, in a silk cocktail dress, twirls. Priya, in a crimson ball gown, descends.

EXT. SHOP - DAY
Raj glances at a watch in the shop window. Priya holds up a red saree for Raj to see. Raj's jacket lies on the chair.

INT. RESTAURANT - NIGHT
A waiter in a white jacket serves Raj.

INT. BAR - NIGHT
A BOUNCER (40), black t-shirt, blocks Raj.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT
Raj pulls his hood up. He turns his collar up.

INT. SCHOOL - DAY (FLASHBACK)
A younger Raj, in school uniform, runs down the corridor.

EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT
Raj shields Priya. Blood runs down his sleeve.

INT. HALL - NIGHT
A waiter wears a very long deeply embroidered heavily starched immaculately pressed brilliantly white finely tailored double breasted beautifully cut formal dinner jacket.

INT. FLAT - DAY
Priya folds Raj's blue shirt and tucks it into the suitcase.

INT. FLAT - DAY
Raj wears a grey hoodie. He zips the grey hoodie up to his chin. The grey hoodie is torn.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY
Raj and Priya stand by the door.
PRIYA:
  Put the coat on the hook, please.
RAJ:
  Take the cap off the bottle for me.
PRIYA:
  Put your watch on the table and listen.
RAJ:
  Don't lose your shirt on this deal.

INT. STUDY - NIGHT
Raj tells Priya the naked truth. Vikram can see it with the naked eye.

INT. LOBBY - DAY
Priya wears nude heels. Priya wears nude lipstick.

INT. STUDY - NIGHT
Raj writes in red. Vikram pays in gold. Priya trades in silk. Raj deals in leather.
The house is in the red.

INT. OFFICE - DAY
The plan is unchanged. The price is the same as before. The schedule gets changed at the last minute.
Raj, Priya and Vikram argue.

INT. ROOM - DAY
Raj is unchanged. Priya's outfit is the same as before.

INT. STUDY - NIGHT
There is a pregnant pause. Raj orders a double for Priya. Vikram drives the older Mercedes.
The idea is pregnant with meaning.

INT. STUDY - NIGHT
Priya's desk is covered in dust. Raj's car is covered in mud. Vikram's phone is smeared with grease.

INT. BAR - NIGHT
Raj orders a double for Priya. Raj sees double for a moment.

INT. OFFICE - DAY
Raj plans the wedding for next year. Diwali is next month. The funeral was last spring.
Priya says the reception at the hotel was awful.

INT. CAFE - DAY
Raj and Priya sit.
PRIYA:
  You bought it at the same dress shop as me.
RAJ:
  It needs the same coat of paint as the hallway.
PRIYA:
  We took the same ring road home.

INT. OFFICE - DAY
Raj sweats the details. Vikram tackles the paperwork. Priya wrestles with her conscience.
The news hits Raj hard. Raj explodes with anger. Vikram chases a lead. Raj puts up a fight over the budget.

INT. NEWSROOM - DAY
A hail of criticism follows. Raj needs some elbow grease. The company bleeds money.
Guilt eats at Priya. The candle flame dances. The final sprint of the campaign begins. Snow White plays on the TV.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
Vikram showers Priya with compliments. Raj eats his words and leaves.

INT. COURT - DAY
Vikram files a suit against the landlord.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
Priya keeps her cards close to her vest. Vikram tightens his belt financially.
Priya throws in the towel. Vikram is an empty suit.

INT. GARAGE - DAY
Raj reads the book's dust jacket. Priya replaces the brake shoes on the car.

INT. OFFICE - DAY
Raj opens the crowd-funding page.

EXT. DRIVEWAY - DAY
Raj props the car hood up and peers at the engine. Priya turns the dog's collar up to read the tag.

INT. RAJ'S FLAT - LAUNDRY ROOM - NIGHT
Raj loads the machine. Priya reads.

INT. HAVELI - DAY
Priya's mehndi is fresh. Priya carries a cloth jhola.
Meera ties her ghungroos. Vikram pulls on a pheran.
Raj's Mother, in a black burkha, waits. Raj adjusts his skull cap and bandi.
Meera wears a red chunri and jootis. Priya's choora and kaleere jingle.
Priya, in a grey pinafore, sits at the front.

INT. ROOM - DAY
Raj wears a signet ring. Priya wears a halter top. Raj wears a skinny tie. Vikram wears a surgical mask. Raj checks his digital watch. Raj wears a Nehru cap. Raj wears a peaked cap.

INT. CAFE - DAY
PRIYA, 30s, sharp bob, black blazer, heels, sits.
VIKRAM (40), crumpled linen suit, no tie, enters.
INSPECTOR PANDEY (50), khaki uniform, cap under his arm, enters.
Raj wears no tie. Priya, in heels, sits.

EXT. SCHOOL - DAY (FLASHBACK)
A YOUNGER RAJ (12) runs across the ground.

INT. OFFICE - DAY
Raj bursts in, sweaty and dishevelled.
Priya is soaked and filthy.
Vikram enters looking bedraggled.
Meera, still damp from the pool, shivers. Raj, still dishevelled, enters.

INT. FLAT - NIGHT
Priya, in a different saree from the morning, sits on the bed.

INT. FLAT - NIGHT
Priya wears a different dress. Raj is in another shirt. Raj wears another kurta.
Vikram, now dressed in a suit, waits. Vikram now wears a suit.
Raj pulls a sweater over his head. Raj pulls a sweater on.

INT. HALL - NIGHT
Raj is dressed as he was at the wedding.
Raj, dressed exactly as in the previous scene, enters.
Raj wears what he wore at the funeral.

INT. BAR - NIGHT
Priya throws her drink in Raj's face. Priya throws wine at Raj.
A cake is smashed into Raj's face.
Raj empties a bucket over Priya's head. Meera throws a bucket of water over Vikram. Meera drenches Vikram with a hose.
The rain soaks Raj to the skin.

INT. HALL - NIGHT
RAJ (35) and PRIYA (30), both in white, enter.

EXT. ROOF - DAY
A stunt double takes the fall for Vikram. Raj's double does the jump.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY
Priya's white salwar is pink with gulal. Priya's saree is ruined. Priya's clothes are ruined.

INT. GYM - DAY
Raj strips to the waist. Raj, shirt off, flexes. Raj has his shirt off.

INT. HOUSE - DAY
TWO WEEKS LATER
Raj enters.

expected.textContains: two weeks later - fresh day change

cases.text:
INT. STAGE - NIGHT
Raj tears his shirt off. Raj sweats through his sherwani.

INT. FLAT - NIGHT
RAJ:
  Take off that wet shirt before you catch a cold.
PRIYA:
  Fine.

INT. BAR - NIGHT
Vikram vomits on his shoes. Vikram vomits down his shirt.

INT. HALL - DAY
Priya is wearing his old sweatshirt.
Priya sits with Vikram. She adjusts her dupatta.

INT. HALL - DAY
Raj carries her bag up the stairs.
Raj sits with Vikram. He loosens his tie.

INT. HALL - DAY
Raj hands Priya a red scarf. Raj hands her a woollen hat.

expected.textContains: hands over red scarf to priya
hands over woollen hat to priya

cases.text:
INT. HALL - DAY
RAJ:
  Priya, take off that coat.
PRIYA:
  Vikram, put on your jacket.

INT. HALL - DAY
Raj, Priya and Vikram sit.
PRIYA:
  Vikram, put on your jacket.

INT. STUDY - NIGHT
Raj reads a letter. Priya enters.
She is wearing his old college sweatshirt.

INT. HALL - DAY
RAJ:
  (to Priya, fixing her earring)
  Hold still.

INT. HALL - DAY
PRIYA:
  (handing Raj his coat)
  Go.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT
Raj hands Priya his jacket.

INT. HALL - DAY
Meera hands Raj Priya's scarf.

INT. ROOM - DAY
Priya picks up Raj's jacket and puts it on.

INT. CAR - NIGHT
Priya takes off her jacket and drapes it over Raj's shoulders.

INT. ROOM - DAY
Raj drops his watch. Priya picks it up and slips it on.

INT. HALL - DAY
Raj's friend wears a leather jacket.

INT. WARD - DAY
Priya, a nurse, wears blue scrubs. Nurse hands Raj a gown.

INT. HALL - DAY
Priya watches as Raj comes in wearing a torn kurta and muddy sandals.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT
Raj imagines Priya in a red dress. Raj remembers Priya in her wedding lehenga. Raj thinks of Priya in a green saree.

EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT
Blood from Raj's nose spatters Vikram's white shirt.

EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT
Vikram grabs Raj by the collar and rips his shirt open.

INT. HALL - DAY
Raj's shirt is soaked with blood.

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING
Raj's kurta is torn at the sleeve.

INT. HOUSE - DAY
Raj's sleeve is singed.

INT. HOUSE - DAY
PRIYA'S MOTHER (55), in a widow's white saree, opens the door.

EXT. POLICE STATION - DAY
Inspector Pandey straightens his khaki uniform. Pandey's cap is missing. The inspector's boots are muddy.

INT. RESTAURANT - NIGHT
A WAITER in a black vest pours water. Raj nods.
cases.note: role word that is also a character name attributes to the character
